[USER] User asked if empathy and compassion can be separated or if they are inherently linked.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Empathy refers to the ability to understand and share the feelings of others.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Compassion involves a desire to alleviate the suffering of others and take action to help them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Empathy can involve feeling the same emotions as another person, while compassion does not necessarily require feeling the same emotions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Empathy can lead to compassion, as one may feel inspired to take action to help someone after empathizing with their pain or struggle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Empathy and compassion are inherently linked, but it is possible to experience one without the other.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example: One may feel empathetic towards someone's pain but not feel a desire to take action to alleviate their suffering.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, it is possible for someone to be highly empathetic but not very compassionate.
